message.content: This editorial illustration is the front cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large, black, serif capital letters. Below it is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". The background is a flat, light purple. On the right, a painted portrait shows a man with dark, short-cropped hair, dark eyes, and a light brown complexion, wearing a white button-down shirt. He faces towards the left. His shadow, cast onto the purple wall behind him, takes the silhouette of a different man with a distinctively longer nose and a different facial structure. To the left of the man, white text reads: "GERILYA UNTUK PUTRA MAHKOTA". Smaller text below it mentions "Gibran Rakabuming Raka", "Prabowo Subianto", and "Jokowi". At the top, headlines include "Salah Kaprah Keadilan Restoratif H.62" and "Remuk Redam Keuangan Indofarma Setelah Pandemi H.78". The bottom right corner features a barcode, a QR code, the date "16-22 OKTOBER 2023", the price "RP 50.000", and other publication details. A solid red bar spans across the top left edge.
